'''Lars Baddeg''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] leader of the [[Justicars' Brigade]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]].

==Biography==
A Human male, Lars Baddeg had ascended to the top of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic's]] Most Wanted List by [[3643 BBY]]. In the wake of the [[Sacking of Coruscant]] years earlier, the [[Justicars' Brigade]] had become a powerful vigilante group in the [[Coruscant Underworld/Legends|Coruscant underworld]]. He ascended to the top ranks of the Justicars after acquiring the [[Noetikon of Secrets]] from the ruins of the [[Jedi Temple/Legends|Jedi Temple]], secretly conspiring with a enigmatic [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] to whom he had promised the artifacts. At the height of his time amid the Justicars' leadership, Baddeg was attempting to acquire the other two Noetikons but was thwarted by a [[The Barsen'thor|young Jedi Consular]] at every turn. Holing himself up in the [[Justicars' Tower]], the young Jedi arrived with a [[Trandoshan/Legends|Trandoshan]] companion named [[Qyzen Fess]] and convinced Baddeg to hand over the Noetikon without a fight. However, he deceived the Jedi by turning over into their custody a [[Fake Noetikon of Secrets|faux-Noetikon]] which was in actuality a [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] trap provided by his clandestine benefactor. Breaking free of the Sith device, the Consular and Fess attacked and killed Baddeg before retrieving the real Noetikon.
